name: deacetylbisacodyl
uses: Use(s) for temporary relief of occasional constipation and irregularity this product generally produces bowel movement in 6 to 12 hours
otcwarn: Do not use if you cannot swallow without chewing Ask a doctor before use if you stomach pain, nausea or vomiting a sudden change in bowel habits that lasts more than 2 weeks Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if Stop use and ask a doctor before use if you have rectal bleeding or fail to have a bowel movement after use of a laxative. These could be signs of a serious condition. you need to use a laxative for more than 1 week
